name: Kashiwagi Kyuuzou
source:
A retired antique dealer who is also [url=/c123786]Tsukishima Narumi[/url]'s mentor.
At first glance, he appears to be a kind and gentle old man, but deep down he seems to be harboring many mysteries and is very well-informed. As a result, he ends up cooperating with [url=/c123784]Kyousuke[/url]'s investigation.

[Translated from [url=https://www.fog.jp/main/products/mp2.html]MP episode 2's official website[/url].]
